svg.text: Upright: 40 x 6 flat bar, 800 long; two 11 holes 50 and 750 up for M10 anchors

svg.text: Arms: two pieces 250 long, welded square to the front face, tops 256 and 506 up

svg.text: Lips: 30 tall, welded on the arm ends so poles cannot roll off
